title: Aaron Glenn explains Jets’ decision to take David Bailey over Arvell Reese in NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Glenn explains Jets’ decision to take David Bailey over Arvell Reese in NFL Draft
sources.description: With the two set to go head-to-head Friday, Jets head coach Aaron Glenn was asked following Monday’s practice what went into the team taking David Bailey over Arvell Reese in the NFL Draft.
